Mapped 14 years and 125k+ papers in Web3: the speculative token boom has cooled, and research has rotated into post-quantum cryptography, L2 scaling, and institutional rails: https://x.com/vedangvatsa/status/2117610390490145224
WEB3 RESEARCH TRENDS
Vedang Ratan Vatsa
veda.ng
ABSTRACT
This study maps OpenAlex works tagged Blockchain or Cryptocurrency from
2013 through mid-2026. The primary corpus is 128,286 papers with those two
concept tags (topic labels from a machine-learning model on title, abstract,
and citations, not plain keyword matches). A broader keyword search finds
1,938,409 works, used only as a coverage check because of false positives. On
the concept-tagged set, annual volume grew about 117x from 2013 to 2025,
then slowed. About 82.7% of papers appeared from 2020 onward. Post-quantum
terms rose fastest from 2022-2023 to 2025-2026 ("quantum resistant" 6.6x). DeFi
abstract attention rose about 43x from 2020 to 2025, while NFT mentions peaked
in 2023 and then fell. China (13.5%) and India (13.3%) lead this corpus; the
United States ranks third (9.7%). About 43.5% of papers have zero citations.
